Name: Farm Cave Storage
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]works with the new SDV 1.5



This is a small overhaul of the farm cave and and an altered version of my old farm cave mod. The goal is to add a little more
use to the cave and give the player more space to store/produce goods.
It tries to blend into the vanilla game (reasonable size and look).

What does it do: (see pictures)

- The cave gets a little extension to the right side, to give the player a little more space for stuff.
- Elevator to a second, deeper level: This are offers space for about 50+ tiles.

NSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

2. download the  Mod
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the folder into your Mods folder.


DEINSTALLATION:
1. remove all things you placed insinde the new area.
2. safe the game.
3. delete the "[CP] Boogie Farm Cave Storage" folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Works with everything that does not edit/replace the FarmCave.tbin Map.

KNOW ISSUES:
1. only tested with mushroom cave.

Thanks for your download, enjoy and let me know if you have any suggestions or find bugs!
